basic_info.headline: Senior BI Engineer | QuickSight, SQL, MicroStrategy | Data Visualization & Analytics
basic_info.about:
I’m a Senior BI Engineer with a decade of experience transforming complex healthcare data into clear, actionable insights that drive better decisions. I specialize in building scalable dashboards, optimizing data models, and improving analytics workflows — always with a focus on clarity, accuracy, and the end-user experience.

My background blends technical expertise (Amazon QuickSight, SQL, MicroStrategy) with hands-on product development. I’ve designed and launched analytics applications, engineered efficient data structures, and collaborated closely with cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that improve operational efficiency, coding accuracy, and clinical outcomes.

Before my career in BI, I led teams in a high-volume healthcare setting, where I improved processes, standardized workflows, and guided a major transition from paper to digital records. That frontline operations experience grounded my approach to analytics: understand the users, simplify the workflow, and build tools that solve real problems.

I’m at my best when I’m:

*Designing intuitive dashboards and semantic layers

*Translating complex requirements into scalable solutions

*Improving processes and reducing manual work

*Helping teams make sense of their data

I’m currently exploring new opportunities where I can contribute as a Senior BI Engineer, Analytics Engineer, or Senior Data Analyst — ideally in an environment that values innovation, clear communication, and continuous improvement.

If you’re looking for someone who builds clean, reliable, user-focused analytics solutions, let’s connect.

experience.title: Medical Records Supervisor
experience.company: St. Peter's Health Partners Medical Associates, Albany Associates in Cardiology
experience.description:
- Managed up to four medical record coordinators in a fast paced, dynamic environment
- Standardized all medical record department tasks for the purposes of training and process
improvement
- Planned and successfully executed a project to eliminate all on-site paper medical record storage
- Transitioned the department to a new medical record software by planning with administrative
personnel, participating in the oversight of successful change-over both within the medical
records department and throughout clerical and clinical departments, and providing post-go-live
support to all staff and members of the practice
- Arranged for clerical and clinical staff to access local hospital electronic medical record systems
for more immediate and effective patient care
